after_plan: Compile immutable typed score events and semantic control operands at audio asset loading. Native event handles and call/repetition continuations drive playback. Notes/rests carry both duration-consumption continuations. Source labels remain only for immutable provenance, debug/legacy snapshot mapping and dormant-error compatibility.
source_probe_findings: parse_to_note clones Driver and commits only after note/rest/stop;4096 zero-time operations remain bounded. A missing duration or invalid command is deferred until its active path executes.
The same mapped byte can be a note duration on one path and an invalid odd command on another. Do not reject all dormant decoded nodes at loading or assume one linear disassembly.
A note may complete with its next cursor outside mapped data; that successor fails only on the next parse. Source address increments wrap16 bits.
Auxiliary stream reads,141-byte envelope/config overlap, host cadence, DSP ordering, note arithmetic and native mixer stay out of scope.
All original mapped byte starts and overlapping segment precedence need source-to-event mapping; arbitrary legacy cursors/stacks must bind without eagerly executing/erroring.

compiler_design_probes: Compile every mapped byte start with last-segment precedence; keep missing/invalid dormant entries as deferred error states rather than rejecting definitions.
A note/rest node needs both explicit-duration and fixed-duration continuation edges; source-address wrapping occurs only at compilation.
Control events need typed semantic payloads so playback does not collect operand vectors or decode LE targets.

Ordinary playheads/call/repetition frames should carry native event handles. Immutable source labels/maps are required at debug/snapshot boundaries; bind legacy cursors/stacks on restore without executing them.
Keep the public legacy snapshot shape and observe sequence labels stable; the census hashes complete state/ordered DSP/PCM, not only final voice summaries.
implementation: ScoreGraph compiles every mapped byte start with last-segment precedence into typed Note/Rest/Control/Fault nodes and native continuation handles. Main playheads/stack targets are EventRef values; immutable source labels support unchanged wire/debug data. Musical repetitions use1..256 native counts with legacy byte encoding. Normal parse has no source-byte reads, opcode decoding, operand-vector construction or target word decoding.
